name: Why do I need professional architectural planning for an ADU?
description: Professional architectural planning ensures ADU compliance with zoning and building codes, maximizes space, and streamlines the permit process.

mainEntity.name: Why do I need professional architectural planning for an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional architectural planning is essential for an ADU to ensure compliance with complex local zoning ordinances and building codes, which can vary significantly even within nearby areas like Fremont or Hayward. Architects bring expertise in maximizing space, ensuring structural integrity, and navigating the permit process efficiently. Attempting to manage these without professional guidance often leads to costly delays, redesigns, or even rejection of permits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional architectural planning ensures ADU compliance with zoning and building codes, maximizes space, and streamlines the permit process.
